::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 24th 1884  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS New York Public Library, De Coursey Fales Collection/1
:::

Dear Madam

I am afraid I cannot tell you which is my favorite tale- they were written with such different feelings and associations

yours truly
C M Yonge
